title: Exclusive: BeautyPro acquires Supercover to bolster colour cosmetics offering
summary: Make-up brand Supercover will relaunch with a redesigned website at supercover.co.uk, which British beauty company BeautyPro said will bring the brand's heritage forward for a new generation of consumers

extraction.key_fact: 영국 뷰티 기업 뷰티프로가 색조 화장품 사업을 강화하기 위해 메이크업 브랜드 슈퍼커버를 인수했다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: BeautyPro acquires Supercover to bolster colour cosmetics offering
